systems.system: Annual School Census (ASC), digital form and platform
systems.platform: digital ASC form maintained by NEMIS
systems.owner: Federal Ministry of Education (NEMIS), with State Ministries of Education and LGEAs
systems.tiers: to be adopted in all states and the FCT under HOPE-EDU DLI 8, with targets of 90% then 95% of schools included in the current-year report; national and state digital ASC systems are disbursement results still to be met at February 2025

systems.country_label: Nigeria Education Management Information System (NEMIS); education management information system
systems.owner: Federal Ministry of Education; the national EMIS team has a minimal budget and issues guidance to states, which finance data collection
systems.tiers: federal, state and LGEA; described only through the annual school census it maintains
data requirements and school codes to be aligned with the ASC platform

note: World Bank assessment of the HOPE-EDU programme: the only education data system it describes is the Annual School Census and its digitisation, with the EMIS strengthened in order to publish it; nothing on per-learner records kept by schools.
